# Outrun API examples **One OpenAI-compatible API key for 96 AI models: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, uncensored and abliterated LLMs, plus image, video and speech models.** Outrun is a prepaid AI API. You top up one USD balance, and every request is billed per use at a published per-token (or per-image, per-second) rate. This repo has copy-paste examples and ready config files for the tools developers already use. ```text Base URL: https://api.outrun.to/v1 Auth: Authorization: Bearer $OUTRUN_API_KEY ``` - Works with the official OpenAI SDKs (Chat Completions and Responses), the Anthropic Messages API for Claude model IDs, and the Gemini native format. - The model ID you send is the model that answers. - Prices: [outrun.to/model/](https://outrun.to/model/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) (every model, its billed price, context and setup values). - Docs: [outrun.to/docs/](https://outrun.to/docs/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) ## Quick start 1. Get a key: sign in at [outrun.to](https://outrun.to/overview?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) or open the Telegram bot [@outrunAPI_Bot](https://t.me/outrunAPI_Bot?start=gh_examples). 2. Put it in an environment variable (never in code or a commit): ```bash export OUTRUN_API_KEY="your-key" ``` 3. Send a request: ```bash curl https://api.outrun.to/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $OUTRUN_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model": "gpt-5.6-sol", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in five words."}]}' ``` ### Python (OpenAI SDK) ```python import os from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.outrun.to/v1", api_key=os.environ["OUTRUN_API_KEY"], max_retries=0) resp = client.chat.completions.create( model="claude-sonnet-5", # or gpt-5.6-sol, gemini-3.8-flash, grok-4.7, deepseek-v4-pro, glm-5.3-abliterated ... messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Say hello in five words."}], ) print(resp.choices[0].message.content) ``` ### Node (OpenAI SDK) ```js import OpenAI from "openai"; const client = new OpenAI({ baseURL: "https://api.outrun.to/v1", apiKey: process.env.OUTRUN_API_KEY, maxRetries: 0 }); const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: "gemini-3.8-flash", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Say hello in five words." }], }); console.log(resp.choices[0].message.content); ``` Change only `model` to switch between GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax and the uncensored models. All IDs are in [CATALOG.md](CATALOG.md). > The examples set `max_retries=0`: every request is billed, so if a request is interrupted, > check Activity in your dashboard before you send it again. ## Prices are kept out of this repo so they can't go stale; the model pages always show the billed rate. ## FAQ **Is Outrun OpenAI-compatible?** Yes. Set the base URL to `https://api.outrun.to/v1` in any OpenAI SDK or tool and use an Outrun key. `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/models`, `/v1/images/generations`, `/v1/audio/speech` and `/v1/videos` are supported. **Can I use Claude models with the Anthropic SDK or Claude Code?** Yes. Claude model IDs work on `/v1/messages` with the `x-api-key` header. In the Anthropic SDK and Claude Code, the base URL is the bare host `https://api.outrun.to`. **How does billing work?** Prepaid. You add credit to one USD balance, and each request is charged at the model's published rate. Eligible new accounts get $0.10 in free API credit to try it. See [billing](https://outrun.to/docs/billing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples). **Does Outrun store my prompts?** Outrun does not store your prompts, images or outputs unless you choose to save them. **Where is a machine-readable model list?** [`https://outrun.to/llms.txt`](https://outrun.to/llms.txt?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) for LLMs and agents, and `https://api.outrun.to/pricing` as JSON. ## Links - Website: [outrun.to](https://outrun.to/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) - All models and prices: [outrun.to/model/](https://outrun.to/model/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) - Docs: [outrun.to/docs/](https://outrun.to/docs/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) - llms.txt: [outrun.to/llms.txt](https://outrun.to/llms.txt?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples) - Telegram bot: [@outrunAPI_Bot](https://t.me/outrunAPI_Bot?start=gh_examples) Found a broken example? # Claude Code with Outrun

Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so it points at the bare host
`https://api.outrun.to` (no `/v1`). Every Claude model works: `claude-opus-5-5`
(default), `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`
and `claude-fable-5`. Each also has a lower-cost route 2: add `-2` to the ID
(for example `claude-opus-5-5-2`).

Full guide: [outrun.to/docs/setup/claude](https://outrun.to/docs/setup/claude?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## 1. Install

```bash
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
```

## 2. Settings file

Merge [`settings.json`](settings.json) into `~/.claude/settings.json`
(Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json`). Keep your other settings, and remove
any `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` entry. Replace `KEY` with your Outrun key on your own machine.

## 3. Or use environment variables (macOS / Linux)

```bash
# Add to ~/.zshrc and/or ~/.bashrc. The base URL is the bare host: no /v1 at the end.
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://api.outrun.to"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$OUTRUN_API_KEY"
export ANTHROPIC_MODEL="claude-opus-5-5"
export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL="claude-opus-5-5"
export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL="claude-sonnet-5-5"
export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL="claude-haiku-5-5"
# Remove any older ANTHROPIC_API_KEY line: having both causes an auth conflict.
```

## 4. Test

Open a new terminal and run `claude`. If you are signed in with an Anthropic account,
run `/logout` first and accept the custom API key if asked. Send `Reply with OK only`.
Switch models with `/model <model>`.

# Cline (VS Code) with Outrun

Cline connects with its **OpenAI Compatible** provider.

Full guide: [outrun.to/docs/setup/cline](https://outrun.to/docs/setup/cline?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## 1. Install

```bash
code --install-extension saoudrizwan.claude-dev
```

## 2. Settings (gear icon in the Cline panel)

```text
API Provider:  OpenAI Compatible
Base URL:      https://api.outrun.to/v1
API Key:       your Outrun key (type it into this field yourself)
Model ID:      claude-sonnet-5
```

Do not append `/chat/completions` to the Base URL. Cline keeps the key in its own settings
screen, so don't write it into a VS Code settings or workspace file.

Other model IDs you can switch to: `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`,
`gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-opus-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`,
`claude-fable-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`,
`gemini-3.7-flash`, `grok-4.7`, `kimi-k3`, `kimi-k3.1-pro`, `MiniMax-M3`,
`deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`,
and the uncensored models `glm-5.3-uncensored`, `glm-5.3-flash-uncensored`,
`glm-5.3-abliterated`, `deepseek-v4-pro-uncensored`. Full list: [CATALOG.md](../../CATALOG.md).

## 3. Test

Click Save or Done, start a new chat and send `Reply with OK only`.

# Codex CLI with Outrun

Codex talks to Outrun through a custom model provider over the OpenAI Responses API.
GPT models: `gpt-6.1-sol` (default), `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-5.6-sol` and
`gpt-5.6-terra`.

Full guide: [outrun.to/docs/setup/codex](https://outrun.to/docs/setup/codex?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## 1. Install

```bash
npm install -g @openai/codex
```

## 2. Key

```bash
echo 'export OUTRUN_API_KEY="your-key"' >> ~/.zshrc   # or ~/.bashrc
```

Windows (PowerShell): `[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("OUTRUN_API_KEY", "your-key", "User")`,
then reopen PowerShell.

## 3. Config

Copy [`config.toml`](config.toml) into `~/.codex/config.toml`
(Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml`). The base URL ends in `/v1`; do not append
`/responses`.

## 4. Test

Run `codex` and send `Reply with OK only`. Switch models with `codex -p gpt-6-astra`
(or `codex -m gpt-6-astra`).

# Continue with Outrun

[Continue](https://github.com/continuedev/continue) connects to Outrun through its `openai`
provider with a custom `apiBase`. The config file [`config.yaml`](config.yaml) holds no secret:
the key is read from the Continue secret `OUTRUN_API_KEY`.

Full API reference: [outrun.to/docs/api](https://outrun.to/docs/api?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## 1. Get a key

Create a key at [outrun.to/key](https://outrun.to/key?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)
and save it in Continue as a secret named `OUTRUN_API_KEY`.

## 2. Add the models

Merge the `models` list from [`config.yaml`](config.yaml) into your Continue `config.yaml`
(open it from the Continue panel's settings). Keep the trailing `/v1/` in `apiBase`.

## 3. Pick a model

Choose `Claude Sonnet 5.5` (or another entry) in the Continue model picker and send
`Reply with OK only` to check the connection.

To add another model, copy an entry and change `name` and `model` to an ID from
[outrun.to/pricing](https://outrun.to/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples),
which also lists current rates.

# Goose with Outrun

[Goose](https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose) can use Outrun as a custom provider. Outrun is an
OpenAI-compatible API, so Goose talks to it through its `openai` engine. The provider file
[`outrun.json`](outrun.json) holds no secret: the key is read from `OUTRUN_API_KEY`.

Full API reference: [outrun.to/docs/api](https://outrun.to/docs/api)

## 1. Get a key

Create a key at [outrun.to/key](https://outrun.to/key) and export it:

```bash
export OUTRUN_API_KEY="your-key"
```

On Windows PowerShell: `$env:OUTRUN_API_KEY = "your-key"`.

## 2. Install the provider file

Copy `outrun.json` into Goose's `custom_providers` directory:

| OS | Directory |
|---|---|
| macOS / Linux | `~/.config/goose/custom_providers/` |
| Windows | `%APPDATA%\Block\goose\config\custom_providers\` |

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/goose/custom_providers
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OutrunAIAPI/outrun-examples/main/configs/goose/outrun.json \
  -o ~/.config/goose/custom_providers/outrun.json
```

Restart Goose Desktop if it is open. This is Goose's documented
[custom provider](https://goose-docs.ai/docs/getting-started/providers#configure-custom-provider)
file format.

## 3. Use it

- **Desktop:** open Settings, then Models, and pick `Outrun` from the provider list. If Goose asks
  for the key, paste it there to store it in the keychain.
- **CLI:** run `goose configure`, choose `Configure Providers`, and select `Outrun`. Or start a
  session directly:

  ```bash
  goose session start --provider outrun
  ```

Pick any listed model, for example `claude-sonnet-5-5` or `gpt-5.6-sol`. The file lists a few
model IDs with their context sizes. To use another model, add an entry to `models` using the ID from
[outrun.to/pricing](https://outrun.to/pricing), which also lists current rates.

## 4. Test

Send `Reply with OK only` and check that the model answers.

# OpenCode with Outrun

OpenCode connects through the `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` provider. The config sets up
every Outrun text model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM and the
uncensored models) on one key. The default is `outrun/claude-opus-5-5`; pick another with
`/models`.

Full guide: [outrun.to/docs/setup/opencode](https://outrun.to/docs/setup/opencode?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## 1. Install

```bash
npm install -g opencode-ai
```

## 2. Key

```bash
echo 'export OUTRUN_API_KEY="your-key"' >> ~/.zshrc   # or ~/.bashrc
```

## 3. Config

Copy [`opencode.json`](opencode.json) to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`
(Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\opencode.json`). It reads the key from
`{env:OUTRUN_API_KEY}`, so the file itself holds no secret.

## 4. Test

Run `opencode`, choose an `outrun/...` model with `/models`, and send `Reply with OK only`.

# Roo Code (VS Code) with Outrun

Roo Code connects with its **OpenAI Compatible** provider. Outrun's guide uses it for the
uncensored and abliterated models; GLM Abliterated and GLM Flash Abliterated were verified
with Roo Code native tool calls. Each model page shows whether it is Roo Code ready and
lists its own setup values.

Full guide: [outrun.to/docs/setup/uncensored](https://outrun.to/docs/setup/uncensored?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=examples)

## Settings

```text
API Provider:        OpenAI Compatible
Base URL:            https://api.outrun.to/v1
API Key:             enter your key locally
Model ID:            glm-5.3-abliterated

# GLM Abliterated / Flash Abliterated model capabilities
Context Window:      1000000
Max Output Tokens:   65536

# Separate request limit, if shown
Include Max Tokens:  on
Request Max Tokens:  1024 for a first test
Streaming:           on
Tool Protocol:       Native
Image Support:       off
Computer Use:        off
```

The capability values above apply to GLM only. For other models, use the limits on that
model's page, and never use the context size as the output-token limit.

Other uncensored model IDs (one Roo profile each): `glm-5.3-uncensored`,
`glm-5.3-flash-uncensored`, `deepseek-v4-pro-uncensored`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated`,
`deepseek-v4.1-flash-abliterated-fast`. Abliterated variants are designed to reduce
refusals; responses can still vary. Full list: [CATALOG.md](../../CATALOG.md).

## Test

Save and select the profile, then send `Reply with OK only`.
